functions.name: addAzureSandboxGroup
functions.description: Adds an Azure Container Apps sandbox group resource to the application model.

functions.name: publishAsAzureSandbox
functions.description: Configures the specified compute resource when it is published as an Azure sandbox container.
functions.remarks:
When the application model contains a single compute environment, Aspire assigns the resource to that environment
automatically. When multiple compute environments exist, call `WithComputeEnvironment` before this method.

functions.name: withAcrPullIdentity
functions.description: Configures the user-assigned managed identity that Azure Dev Compute uses to pull sandbox images from the configured Azure Container Registry.
functions.remarks:
The supplied identity must be attached to an existing sandbox group and have the `AcrPull`
role on its registry. For sandbox groups created by Aspire, the identity is attached automatically,
but the caller remains responsible for granting `AcrPull`.

functions.name: withNoManagedIdentity
functions.description: Clears the managed identities explicitly configured for sandbox workloads.
functions.remarks:
Workload identities requested by individual compute resources are added to the sandbox group during
deployment preparation. Image pulls require a separate user-assigned identity. Aspire creates one by
default for new groups; callers can select one with `WithAcrPullIdentity` and must do so for existing groups.

functions.name: withSystemAssignedIdentity
functions.description: Configures a system-assigned managed identity for sandbox workloads.

functions.name: withUserAssignedIdentity
functions.description: Adds a user-assigned managed identity for sandbox workloads.
functions.remarks:
Image pulls require a separate user-assigned identity. Aspire creates one by default for new groups;
callers can select one with `WithAcrPullIdentity` and must do so for existing groups.
